text:
nidhi: FYI — planning a thin schema migration for the embeddings index that requires a router routing-rule tweak (route by tenant-id -> shard mapping) and a runtime cache warm before cutover. Window: Mon 05:00-05:30 UTC. Low-perf risk but cross-service pin + cache warm is required.
oz: Can you describe the warm strategy? We don't want cold-lookup spikes hitting KV or causing evictions.
nidhi: Plan: 1) pin router -> 3.3.5; 2) pin api -> 1.14.5; 3) runtime receives warm job that prefetches top N vectors per-tenant into local prefix cache (job runs on a small canary pool). Canary sequence: warm job (10m) -> 5% serve with warm flag -> 25% -> 100%.
marta: Need exact commands and rollback steps. Also add console to read-only for devtools to avoid accidental reindexes during the window.
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "3.3.5", window: "2026-04-12T05:00:00Z/2026-04-12T05:30:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.14.5", window: "2026-04-12T05:00:00Z/2026-04-12T05:30:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Quiet-window scheduled at 04:50 UTC. Autoscaler warmup disabled for 10m. Metric watch added: runtime/cache-miss-rate > 3% -> notify #eng-oncall + this thread.
oz: Rollback plan: router traffic swap back to 3.3.4, runtime unset warm flag, and kill warm-job. Commands: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 3.3.5 --to 3.3.4 --instant`; `deployctl job stop warm-embed-prefetch --group runtime-canary`; `deployctl feature unset --service runtime --flag embed-warm`.
nidhi: Prefetch job will target hot tenants only (list uploaded to S3). Warm job container runs with lower priority and rate-limit to avoid KV spikes.
marta: I'll freeze console write APIs for the window and post a banner: "Embedding schema migration in progress — avoid reindex ops".
deploy-bot: warm job queued: warm-embed-prefetch -> runtime-canary-1 (ETA 6m).
qa-bot: Preflight checks: index-schema-compat, router-route-test, runtime-prefetch-smoke queued.
sre-bot: Monitor group created: runtime/cache-miss-rate, kv/latency-95th. Alert if kv/latency-95th > 50ms.
oz: Start warm job now and run quick smoke in 5m. If misses drop > 80% we proceed to 5% canary.
deploy-bot: warm-embed-prefetch started on runtime-canary-1 by nidhi at 05:02 UTC.
qa-bot: smoke: prefetch job completed for 12 tenants, cache-hit improved from 21% -> 84% on canary.
marta: Console read-only enforced. Release notes draft updated with migration steps and rollback commands. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/1777009999-embed-migrate
oz: Proceeding to 5% serve with warm flag.
deploy-bot: runtime flagged: embed-warm enabled for 5% canary. router slice 5% -> 3.3.5.
sre-bot: Alert: runtime/cache-miss-rate spiked to 6% on non-canary nodes — investigating noise.
nidhi: That spike looks from a downstream batch job hitting old tenant IDs, I've paused that job.
sre-bot: Cache-miss-rate back down to baseline. KV latencies within SLO.
oz: Bump to 25% after 10m if metrics hold.
deploy-bot: runtime scaled to 25% embed-warm; router traffic adjusted accordingly.
qa-bot: smoke: embedding lookup latency +4ms p50, p95 +18ms — within acceptable.
marta: Docs-bot: adding migration KB and troubleshooting steps for support.
docs-bot: KB draft published: "Embedding schema migration — triage and rollback" https://redwood.internal/kb/embeds-migrate-1777009999
sre-bot: metric watch now: router/5xx > 2/min || kv/latency-95th > 50ms -> page oncall.
oz: All green at 25%. Ready to go 100% at 05:20 if no regressions for 5m.
qa-bot: final smoke at 05:18: pass.
deploy-bot: routing rolled to 3.3.5 (100%) by marta at 05:21 UTC. runtime embed-warm rolled to 100%.
sre-bot: No elevated 5xx, kv latencies stable; cache hit maintained ~82%.
nidhi: Post-deploy checklist: disable warm job, unpin after 1h, and remove console read-only banner.
deploy-bot: warm job stopped: warm-embed-prefetch -> completed and removed. pin cleared: router 3.3.5 unpinned. pin cleared: api 1.14.5 unpinned.
marta: Removing console banner.
sre-bot: Closing monitor watch; will keep a trend alert for 24h.
oz: Thanks team — nice coordinated run. I'll file a short runbook update with the warm-job pattern.
nidhi: Summary: performed schema-aware router tweak with warm-cache strategy, pinned services, ran staged canary (5/25/100), observed stable metrics, removed pins and warm jobs. Follow-ups: add automated warm-run to CI and add test for tenant list hydration (TKT-8912).
docs-bot: Postmortem link queued for tomorrow with artifacts and metrics.
